question: How is the manifest-unmanifest sign characterized in scripture?
premises: This sign consists of man and power.
It is both manifest and unmanifest.
Scripture describes it as flowering with the sap of the fruit of accomplishment.
inference: The manifest-unmanifest sign, composed of man and power, is taught as the source that yields the fruit of accomplishment.
plain_english: This sign, consisting of man and power and being both manifest and unmanifest, is said in scripture to blossom with the sap of the fruit of accomplishment.
